verses.text: ‘If someone steals an ox or sheep and kills or sells it, they must pay back five oxen for an ox, or four sheep for a sheep. ⚖️
‘If a thief is caught breaking in at night and is struck dead, the person who struck them isn’t guilty of murder. 🌙
‘But if it happens after sunrise, killing the thief is murder. The thief must pay back what was stolen. If they can’t pay, they must be sold to cover the loss. ⚖️
‘If the stolen animal is found alive in the thief’s possession—whether ox, donkey, or sheep—the thief must pay back double. 🐂
‘If someone lets their animal loose and it eats up another person’s field or vineyard, they must repay the loss with the best produce from their own field or vineyard. 🌾
‘If a fire spreads through thorn bushes and burns grain stacks, standing grain, or a field, whoever started the fire must pay for everything burned. 🔥
‘If someone entrusts money or goods to a neighbor for safekeeping, and it’s stolen from the neighbor’s house, then if the thief is found, the thief must pay back double. 🪙
‘If the thief isn’t found, the homeowner must come before God to determine whether they stole their neighbor’s property. ⚖️
‘For any dispute over an ox, donkey, sheep, clothing, or any lost item someone claims is theirs, both parties must come before God. Whoever God finds guilty must pay the other person double. ⚖️
‘If someone entrusts a donkey, ox, sheep, or any animal to a neighbor, and it dies, gets hurt, or is driven away with no one seeing what happened, 🐑
‘the two of them must make an oath before Yahweh that the keeper didn’t take the neighbor’s property. The owner must accept the oath, and the keeper doesn’t have to repay. 🙏
‘But if it was stolen from the keeper, the keeper must repay the owner. 💰
‘If a wild animal tore it apart, the keeper must bring the remains as evidence. They don’t have to repay what was torn apart. 🐑
‘If someone borrows an animal or item from a neighbor and it gets hurt or dies while the owner isn’t there, the borrower must repay the owner. ⚖️
‘If the owner is there, the borrower doesn’t have to repay. If the animal or item was hired, the loss is covered by the rental payment. 🪙
‘If a man seduces an unmarried young woman who isn’t promised to anyone and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price and marry her. 💍
‘But if her father completely refuses to give her to him, the man must still pay the bride-price required for a virgin. ⚖️
‘Do not allow a sorceress to live. ⚠️
‘Anyone who has sex with an animal must be put to death. ⚠️
‘Anyone who sacrifices to a god other than Yahweh must be destroyed. 🙏
‘Don’t mistreat or oppress a foreigner. Remember, you were foreigners living in Egypt. 🤝
‘Don’t take advantage of a widow or a child without a father. 🛡️
‘If you take advantage of them and they cry out to me, I will surely hear them. 🙏
‘My anger will burn against you, and I’ll put you to death with the sword. Then your wives will become widows and your children fatherless. ⚠️
‘If you lend money to one of my poor people, don’t treat them like a creditor would. Don’t charge them interest. 🤝
‘If you take your neighbor’s cloak as collateral, return it before sunset. 🌇
‘It’s their only covering, the garment against their skin. What else will they sleep in? When they cry to me, I’ll hear them, because I am gracious. 🛌
‘Don’t insult God or curse one of your people’s rulers. ⚖️
‘Don’t hold back the first of your harvest or the first juice from your presses. Give me your firstborn sons. 🌾
‘Do the same with your cattle and sheep. Let the young animal stay with its mother for seven days; on the eighth day, give it to me. 🐑
‘You must be holy people for me. Don’t eat meat from an animal torn apart in the field; throw it to the dogs.’ 🐕
